international.notes: ULS’s Oficina de Relaciones Internacionales supports international mobility and states that it facilitates the integration of external students and academics. I found no official evidence that any Medicine course is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: ULS is a Chilean state university founded in 1981. Its current programme listing places Medicine under the Vicerrectoría Académica, rather than under a separate Faculty of Medicine.
Medicine opened in 2026. The official programme page records a 12-semester Médico Cirujano degree; ULS reported that its first cohort started in March 2026.
The clinical link identified on ULS’s own site is the Hospital de La Serena and its CDT. ULS states that students will undertake part of their clinical training there.

For a rheumatologist, this is a very early-stage medical school: ULS identifies a Department and School of Medicine, but this search found no official rheumatology unit or specialty/beca programme. The current recruitment attachment needs direct follow-up before applying.
